projects.name: OmniDrop
projects.title: OmniDrop
projects.description: OmniDrop is a local file-sharing app for Android and Windows. Pair devices using a verification code, choose a same-Wi-Fi or Wi-Fi Direct connection, and send files with transfer progress and controls. The app also includes chat, clipboard sharing, transfer history, themes, and a built-in file explorer.
projects.note: OmniDrop supports trusted-device pairing and encrypted file transfers. Users choose the transfer route, and incoming transfers require approval. Wi-Fi Direct requires compatible device and system support.

projects.name: OmniDeck
projects.title: OmniDeck
projects.description: OmniDeck lets you play your PC games on an Android phone while the game runs on Windows. The host captures and streams video and audio to the phone, and the Android app sends your inputs back to the PC. Players can customize the on-screen layout for each game or use a physical gamepad.
projects.story: OmniDeck lets you play your PC games on an Android phone while the game runs on Windows. The host captures and streams video and audio to the phone, and the Android app sends your inputs back to the PC. Players can customize the on-screen layout for each game or use a physical gamepad.
projects.note: Move, resize, and arrange on-screen buttons and joysticks to suit each game. Save your layouts as presets so you can switch between games without rebuilding your controls.

projects.name: PageAtlas
projects.title: PageAtlas
projects.description: Capture any website or web app as a visual design review: full-page and mobile scroll screenshots, linked-page exploration, a page structure map, and offline HTML or PDF export.
projects.note: PageAtlas doesn't stop at the first page. It follows links and clicks tabs, menus and navigation buttons to capture up to 30 views. It can also capture pages behind a sign-in through a temporary browser window. Then it packs the whole review into one HTML file that opens without internet.

projects.name: DineFlow

projects.description: A full-stack restaurant platform connecting reservations, ordering, payments, and delivery in one role-based workspace for customers and restaurant teams.

projects.story: Staff can arrange and publish restaurant layouts. Customers explore the floor in first person, walk to an available table, and press E to open its booking dialog. Role-based tools support reservations, menu and order management, kitchen service, payments, and delivery.
